items.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Stock Could Be Undervalued After Its 74% Five Year Run
items.summary: Microsoft is trading near record territory after years of strong gains, and the question now is whether the cash the business generates can support a share price of about US$555.8. Over the past 5 years, Microsoft has returned 74.2% which puts a lot of investor confidence into focus around how durable its cash generation really is. items.title: Top 3 AI Infrastructure Stocks To Watch In November 2026
